source: The stump was like every stump that ever existed.
target: Truncus erat sicut omne truncus, qui umquam exstiterit.

source: It was so generic that it looked positively wrong in a game that strived for such perfection in graphical fidelity.
target: Tam vulgare erat ut prorsus iniuste videbatur in ludo, qui ad talem perfectionem fidelitatis graphicae contendebat.

source: It was as if somebody placed a stump from a game from the past into Magic Unbound.
target: Velut si aliquis truncum e ludo antiquae aetatis in Magic Unbound posuisset.

source: The look just didn’t fit.
target: Aspectus prorsus non conveniebat.

source: Despite that, and the odd thoughts it generated in his head, Sam’s attention wasn’t on the stump, but on the presence next to said stump.
target: Nihilominus, et eximias cogitationes quas in eius capite excitavit, attentio Sam non in trunco, sed in praesentia iuxta illum truncum consistit.

source: A presence which before now had been invisible, but now the outlines were slowly emerging thanks to the slowly falling silvery mollusc powder.
target: Praesentia, quae antea invisibilis erat, nunc lineamenta paulatim apparere coepit, propter pulverem molluscorum argenteum, lente cadentem.

source: It was an odd shape and thanks to it being well, invisible, Sam couldn’t make out much, but at least he could see that it had antennae.
target: Forma insolita erat, et propter quod, utique, invisibilis erat, Sam non plura discernere poterat, sed saltem videre poterat quod antennae haberet.

source: Or very weird hair…
target: Vel etiam capilli valde insueti…

source: He stood there silently, hiding his triumph, and stared at the monster just as the monster stared at him.
target: Illic silentium servans, triumphum suum celans, stetit et monstrum intuerebat, sicut monstrum in eum intuebatur.

source: Despite not seeing the being's eyes, he could feel their intense gaze on him.
target: Etsi oculos illius entitatis non videbat, tamen intensum eorum aspectum super se sentiebat.

source: Slowly, the silvery powder finished falling, settling on the ground, on him and Lucky (the wolf sneezing and setting off clouds of sparklescale explosion with it) and on the monster.
target: Lente, pulvis argenteus caderet, consedens in terram, in eum, in Lucky (lupus sternutans et nubes scintillantium eruptionis excitans) atque in monstrum consederat.

source: Sadly, even with that, he couldn’t even tell what kind of monster it was.
target: Tristiter, etiam cum hoc, quid genus monstri esset, cognoscere non poterat.

source: Slowly, he readied his magic, just let it brim under his skin, his Mana Shield almost shining with the potential of the mana he was channelling into it, and his hand was almost white from gripping the handle of his sword.
target: Lente magicam vim parabat, eam sub cute sua effundens; scutum manae paene fulgebat ex potentia manae in eum canalizata, et manus eius, manubrium gladii tenens, paene alba erat.

source: Sam didn’t want to fight; he didn’t need to fight, and he was pretty sure if he tried to fight it directly, he would die within a second.
target: Sam non voluit pugnam; pugnandi ei non opportebat, et certus erat, si directe pugnare conaretur, intra unam secundam moriturum esse.

source: This was at least a boss-level monster.
target: Hoc saltem erat monstrum gradus praecipuus.

source: You needed to be either overpowered beyond belief or with a group to defeat it.
target: Necesse erat aut nimis potentem esse, aut cum grege eum superare.

source: But that was him.
target: Sed ille ipse erat.

source: The monster could still decide to kill him…
target: Monstrum tamen adhuc decernere poterat ut eum occideret…

source: As he was ruminating about the possibility of a solo boss fight, and glancing around the clearing looking for spots to hide behind or otherwise use for the fight (and finding almost none), a quiet sound was heard.
target: Dum de possibilitate pugnae solitariae cum duce meditaret et in area aperta loca quaerebat ad se celandum vel ad pugnam, (paene nihil inveniens) sonus quietus auditus est.

source: A sniff.
target: Inhalatio.

source: Then a musical voice, gentle but with an undercurrent of steel.
target: Deinde vox musicus, lenis sed subtextu ferreo, emissa est.

source: It was as if a zither came to life (which Sam only recognized because one of his friends decided one year to really get into zithers) and decided that from now on it would be capable of speaking.
target: Velut si cithara animam susceperit (quam Sam cognovit solum quia unus ex amicis eius aliquo anno ad citharas vere immersus est) et decrevit ex hoc tempore loqui posse.

source: “So crude, child of man…”
target: “Tam rudis, puer hominis…”

source: Before Sam could even open his mouth to answer, the form next to the malformed stump shimmered, the sparklescale powder lifting off of it falling to the ground, and finally revealing the monster.
target: Priusquam Sam os aperiret ut responderet, forma iuxta truncum deformem micavit, pulveris scintillantis levans in terram cadens, tandem monstrum revelans.

source: ‘It’s a cricket,’ was Sam’s only thought.
target: “Gryllus est,” solum Sam cogitavit.

source: ‘A giant. fricking. cricket.’
target: “Gryllus ingens. Per deos. Gryllus.”

source: It stood on two legs, which looked exactly like one would expect a cricket’s legs to look like, but weirdly humanized, yet not.
target: Super duos crus stabat, quae prorsus erant ut crura grylli exspectari debent, sed mirabiliter humanatae, tamen non plane.

source: Its body, colored black with red accents, was covered by a weird yellow shawl, almost see-through, yet not.
target: Corpus eius, nigro tinctum cum accentibus rubris, tegebatur ab insolito flavo pallio, paene translucido, sed non omnino.

source: Its hands were segmented like an insect’s yet ended in weirdly segmented but human-like hands.
target: Manus eius segmentatae erant ut insecti, sed evenerunt in manus eximie segmentatas, sed quasi humanas.

source: On its head were antennae jutting up high in the air.
target: In capite eius erant antennae, alte in aere protrudentes.

source: And one of them had a cute yellow bow on it.
target: Et una eorum portabat arcum flavescens, venustum.

source: Its face was the weirdest.
target: Vultus eius erat maxime insolitus.

source: Instead of an insect’s face, it was like someone mixed human and insect together but moved the slider towards human more.
target: Pro facie insecti, videbatur quasi aliquis humanum et insectum misceret, attamen maiore ratione ad humanum inclinatus.

source: It had a mouth, nose, eyes and even a slight chin, yet the teeth were sharp, almost shark-like and the eyes were giant and it had no sclera instead it was all yellow.
target: Habebat os, nasum, oculos atque etiam parvum mentum, sed dentes acuti erant, paene ut squalorum, oculi ingentes erant, et sclera non videbatur, cum totus flavo colore fulgentes.

source: Sunshine yellow.
target: Flavus ut radii solis.

source: It wasn’t the weirdest monster he had seen in his inherited memories, but Sam had to say it was up there.
target: Non erat id monstrum maximum insuetus, quod in memoriam hereditariam viderat, sed Sam fatebatur id esse inter se summum.

source: “Oh, my… soooo forceful with your gaze, child of man,” she spoke again, turning away slightly, acting demurely.
target: “O me… tam vehementer cum tuo aspectu, puer hominis,” iterum locuta est, leviter se avertens, modeste agens.

source: “I think I might fear for my… innocence!”
target: “Puto me fortasse timere meam innocentiam!”

source: There was a silence following that, and Sam could only hear crickets in the background.
target: Postea silentium sequebatur, et Sam solum gryllos in obscuro audire poterat.

source: Throwing a deadpan gaze at the monster, he spoke up.
target: Ad monstrum vultu imperturbato intueretur, et locutus est.

source: “Really?”
target: “Revera?”

source: The giant cricket monster turned back, and with a slight smirk on her face (based on the voice) answered.
target: Monstrum grylli ingentis revertere, et leviter subridens vultu respondit.

source: “I stay true to my roots, child of man,” and then her entire demeanor shifted.
target: “Fidelis sum radicibus meis, puer hominis,” et tum totus habitus eius mutatus est.

source: Gone was the playful smile, or airy personality.
target: Risus ludibundus et indoles levis evanuerunt.

source: Instead, it was replaced by a look as hard as a diamond and a threatening aura.
target: Proinde, substitutus est vultu durissimo velut adamas et aura minax.

source: “Why have you come to my little slice of paradise? Why have you wrought destruction on my beautiful creations? Why should I not erase your pitiful song from this world? Answer me, child of man.”
target: “Cur ad partem parvam paradisii mei veneris? Cur exitium in creationibus meis pulchris adduxisti? Cur non deleam carmen tuum miserum ex hoc mundo? Responde mihi, puer hominis.”

source: Taken aback by the rapid change, Sam took a moment to consider the questions.
target: Sam, celeriter mutato conspectu, parva temporis spatium ad quaestiones meditandas cepit.

source: Fighting was absolutely out of the question.
target: Pugnare omnino non erat in ratione.

source: Now that she wasn’t hiding anymore, he could feel the monster’s monstrous mana.
target: Iam, cum non se celaret, poterat sentire monstri vim manae ingentem.

source: He would be squashed in seconds, just as he suspected.
target: In paucis momentis conteri foret, prorsus ut suspicabatur.

source: So, he did the only thing he could.
target: Igitur id quod ei solum possibile erat, fecit.

source: He bowed.
target: Se inclinavit.

source: “My apologies, er… your majesty?”
target: “Ignosce mihi, er… vestra maiestas?”

source: A flash of humor ran through her face, but in an instant, the cold look was back.
target: Subito facetia vultus eius perlata est, sed statim aspectus frigidus redivit.

source: “I’m no monarch, child of man.”
target: “Non sum regina, puer hominis.”

source: “Understood, ma’am,” he replied, swallowing hard.
target: “Intelligo, domina,” respondit, difficulter deglutiens.

source: “I’m here looking for an artifact to lift a curse most foul.”
target: “Adsum quaerens artefactum ad tollendam maledictionem foedissimam.”

source: “A curse most foul you say…” came the melodic words from the monster.
target: “Maledictio foedissima, dicis…” inquit verba melodica ex monstro.

source: “And you need my adorable self for this artifact? How curious…”
target: “Et opus habes mihi, amabilem meam, ad hoc artefactum? Quam curiosum…”

source: “No, ma’am,” spoke up Sam before the monster could get the wrong idea.
target: “Non, domina,” inquit Sam, priusquam monstrum rem male interpretaret.

source: “Oh? Do elaborate, child of man,” came the calm order.
target: “Oh? Expone amplius, puer hominis,” inquit cum tranquillo ordine.

source: Though Sam was relieved to hear that the threatening steel was finally absent from her voice.
target: Sam solacium cepit ex auditu quod minas ferreas tandem in voce eius non erant.

source: “I’m looking for something called Chalice of Restraint.”
target: “Quaero aliquid, quod Calix Moderationis vocatur.”

source: It can be used to safely remove the curse from the person afflicted with it.
target: Adhiberi potest ut maledictionem ex persona affecta tuto removeat.

source: According to my sources, it is hidden around here.
target: Ex fontibus meis, circa hic latet.

source: Sam hoped his honesty would allow him to continue on his journey, and as he carefully watched the monster, he knew he made the right decision.
target: Sam sperabat honestate sua iter suum pergere posse, et dum monstrum caute contemplabatur, scivit se rectum decrevisse.

source: “I see,” said the monster, slowly considering his words, tilting her head slightly and putting one hand up to her face with the other supporting the first hand.
target: “Intellego,” inquit monstrum, lente verba eius considerans, caput leviter inclinans, unam manum ad faciem levans, altera eam opem ferens.

source: A very picture of a fine lady.
target: Imago praeclarae dominae erat.

source: “And was I hindering in your journey, child of man?”
target: “Et an iter tuum impedivi, puer hominis?”

source: “Not… really, ma’am.”
target: “Non… re vera, domina.”

source: There was no answer, only the monster’s stare, so he hastily continued.
target: Responsio nulla fuit, solum intuitus monstri; itaque festinanter continuavit.

source: “My source, an old ranger, has asked me to check up on the area, as it is considered valuable – historically – to the city.
target: Fons meus, senex custos silvarum, me rogavit ut regionem explorarem, quae historice urbi pretiosa habetur.

source: “Your existence came up in our discussion.”
target: Existentia tua in sermone nostro emersa est.

source: “And what did this old ranger ask you to do with my exquisite form?”
target: “Et quid hoc senex custos silvarum tibi iussit de mea forma exquisita facere?”

source: “Nothing nefarious, I assure you. He simply wanted to make sure that the area with the ironwood trees is healthy and hale.
target: “Nihil nefarium, tibi certo confirmo. Ille solum voluit cur regio arboribus ligni ferrei sita bene sani esset.

source: No mention of extermination was made.
target: Nulla de exterminatione dicta est.

source: “Hmm…”
target: “Hmm…”

source: Sam watched as the giant cricket considered him and his words.
target: Sam spectabat dum monstrum grylli ingentis eum et verba eius contemplaret.

source: They stood there in silence, occasionally broken by Lucky, who was playing in the silvery powder as if it was snow.
target: Illic silentium regnabat, interdum intermissum per Lucky, qui in pulveri argenteo quasi neve luderet.

source: Finally, the monster nodded.
target: Denique monstrum annuit.

source: “I believe you, child of man.”
target: “Te credo, puer hominis.”

source: Sam’s shoulder might have sagged a little, hearing that.
target: Scapula Sam paulum labefactata videtur, id audito.

source: And based on the smirk on the monster’s face, she saw it.
target: Et ex risu in facie monstri, ipsa rem intellexit.

source: “Then I think we should part here, ma’am. I don’t want to trouble you with my presence any longer!”
target: “Ergo puto nos hic divergere oportere, domina. Non volo te ultra mea praesentia vexare!”

source: One hand moved onto her chin, and she shot him a mischievous smile, causing a shiver to go down his spine.
target: Una manus ad mentum eius accessit, et illa ei risum malitiosum dimisit, quod tremorem per spinam eius provocavit.

source: “I don’t think so!”
target: “Non puto!”

source: “Excuse me?”
target: “Quid?”

source: The monster just ignored his question and continued to talk.
target: Monstrum quaestionem eius neglexit et ulterius loquebatur.

source: “I’d like to see this mysterious artifact.”
target: “Vellem videre hoc arcanum artefactum.”

source: Sam could feel the dread pooling in his stomach.
target: Sam poterat sentire formidinem in ventre suo confluere.

source: “What?”
target: “Quid?”

source: There wasn’t any answer, instead, the monster began glowing with eerie purple light, and before Sam could blink more than a few times, the giant cricket standing on two legs was gone from his sight, to be replaced by a normal cricket sitting on the weird stump, albeit red and black and slightly bigger than the average cricket.
target: Nulla responsio fuit; sed monstrum incipiebat nitere lumine purpureo sinistro, et antequam Sam pluries oculos concluderet, monstrum grylli ingentis super duos crus stantem ex conspectu eius evanuit, substitutus a gryllo ordinario sedente super truncum insolitum, rubro et nigro, et paulo maiore quam gryllus mediocris.

source: Sam could only stare at it.
target: Sam solum ad eum spectare potuit.

source: “It is an odd feeling, but I suppose that’s where whimsy took me today…” came the melodic sound from the cricket on the stump, accompanied by a zither-like giggle.
target: “Sensatio insueta est, sed puto me hodie in levitatem duxi…” inquit vox melodica a gryllo in trunco sedente, cum risu simili citharae comitante.

source: Sam just sighed.
target: Sam tantum suspiravit.

source: Then, with a powerful jump, the cricket vaulted on top of his head.
target: Tum, saltu valido, gryllus super caput eius transiliit.

source: She spent a few moments getting comfortable, with Sam feeling some kind of magic anchoring her to his head, before exclaiming.
target: Illa paucis momentis se accommodavit, dum Sam aliquam vim magicam, eam in capite suo adligantem, sentiret, antequam exclamat.

source: “Onward noble steed! Let us enjoy the songs of adventure!”
target: “Procite, equus nobilis! Gaudeamus carmina adventura!”

source: Sam stood there silently, trying to calculate how much success he would have convincing the monster that could crush him with a swipe of her finger to not come with him.
target: Sam illic silentium servans stetit, conatus aestimare quantum successus esset, ad persuadendum monstrum, quod uno digiti ictu eum conterere posset, ut se non comiteret.

source: He came up with zero.
target: Nihil computavit.

source: “However, I will not fight your fights for you, child of man. This is your adventure. I’m merely an observer.”
target: “Attamen, certamina tua pro te non pugnabo, puer hominis. Hoc est iter tuum. Ego tantum spectator sum.”

source: There was a slight pause, and Sam could feel the smirk on her face.
target: Brevis mora fuit, et Sam subridentem vultum eius sentire poterat.

source: “Do be entertaining, though. I have been somewhat bored as of late…”
target: “Esto tamen iucunda; nuper aliquantulum taedebam.”

source: Sam looked up at the sky, looking for some kind of divine help, but neither the gods nor the developers appeared.
target: Sam in caelum aspexit, quaerens aliquam auxilium divinum, sed nec dei nec excogitatores apparuerunt.

source: Though one of the clouds looked suspiciously like a smiley face.
target: Quamquam una ex nubibus videbatur, quasi facies subridentis.

source: Finally, he just shrugged and spoke up.
target: Denique, ille umeros levavit et locutus est.

source: “My name is Sam…”
target: “Nomen meum est Sam…”

source: After gaining an impromptu observer for the rest of his quest, Sam spent a few minutes taking stock of his equipment making sure nothing was too damaged, spent a few minutes patting Lucky’s head then squared his shoulders and once again stepped on the path that he tried so many times before.
target: Postquam obsidionem improvisam ad reliquam quaestionis partem adeptus est, Sam paucos minutas consumpsit ut supellectilem suam recenseret, cavens ne quid nimis laesum esset; postea paucos minutas Lucky caput fovens, deinde humeros sternens et iterum in viam, quam toties antea conatus erat, ingressus est.

source: Thankfully, this time he couldn’t feel the subtle shifts of an illusion constraining him.
target: Grato animo, hoc tempore subtila illusionis motus eum non premere sentiebat.

source: Although, the cricket noises were still there.
target: Attamen sonitus gryllorum adhuc erant.

source: Trying to ignore it, he turned his attention to something else.
target: Conans id neglegere, attentionem ad aliquid aliud convertit.

source: Now that his ‘battle’ was over, he could finally review his gains.
target: Iam, cum "pugna" eius finita esset, tandem sua merita recensere poterat.

source: And boy, were there a lot of screens.
target: Et, pro certo, multa erant ostensiones visuales.

source: Thankfully, the game was nice enough to consolidate the notices, and he wasn’t bombarded with every little thing.
target: Grato animo, ludus erat satis benignus ut notificationes coalescerentur, et non omni parva re tormentaretur.

source: [Congratulations! You’ve leveled up!]
target: [Congratulationes! Gradum attigisti!]

source: [You’re now Level 19!]
target: [Nunc es Gradus 19!]

source: [Gained 4 unassigned attribute points!]
target: [Quattuor puncta attributorum nondistributa adeptus es!]

source: [Gained 2 MAG points for your extensive and creative use of magic!]
target: [Duo puncta MAG adeptus es propter usum magiae amplum et creativum!]

source: [Gained +1 AGI, DEX, END for going beyond what your body is capable of!]
target: [Acceperis +1 AGI, DEX, END propter id quod ultra limites corporis tui pervenisti!]

source: Before continuing, he quickly opened his status screen and added two points to vitality and two to strength, just to make sure he was balanced.
target: Antequam pergere, celeriter paginam statum suum aperuit et duos punctos ad vitalitatem et duos ad fortitudinem addidit, ut se aequum esse confirmaret.

source: [Name: Sam ‘Solar’  Level: 19 (37%)  Title: Magical Genius  HP: 240/240  MP: 1105/1260  STR: 12  DEX: 13  AGI: 12  VIT: 12  END: 14  PER: 15  MAG: 21  WIS: 15  LUCK: 11]
target: [Nomine: Sam ‘Solar’  Gradus: 19 (37%)  Titulus: Ingenium Magicum  HP: 240/240  MP: 1105/1260  STR: 12  DEX: 13  AGI: 12  VIT: 12  END: 14  PER: 15  MAG: 21  WIS: 15  LUCK: 11]

source: ‘I really need to do something about my HP’ he scowled as he carefully bounded through the forest towards his goal.
target: “Revera aliquid de HP meo agendum habeo,” inquit Sam, vultu contristo, dum diligenter per silvas ad propositum suum contendebat.

source: Next came the skill gains.
target: Deinde adeptus est incrementum peritiarum.

source: [Advanced Mana Control is now level 10!]
target: [Imperium Manae provectum nunc gradus 10 est!]

source: [Thanks to keeping the flow of your mana during a stressful time, you gained the sub-skill, Stable Mana Control!]
target: [Propter servandam fluxum manae tuae in tempore arduo, adeptus es sub-peritia, Stabilis Imperium Manae!]

source: [Stable Mana Control: Level 0/10 (0%) (Passive) Decreases the chance of outside forces disrupting your control over your own mana.]
target: [Stabilis Imperium Manae: Gradus 0/10 (0%) (Passivum) Occasio virium extranearum, quae imperium manae tuae perturbare conantur, minuit.]

source: [Mana Shield is now Level 26!]
target: [Scutum Manae nunc gradus 26 est!]

source: [Controlled Mana Shield is now Level 8!]
target: [Scutum Manae Moderatum nunc gradus 8 est!]

source: [Sustained Mana Shield is now Level 4!]
target: [Scutum Manae Sustentatum nunc gradus 4 est!]

source: [Mana Sense is now Level 20!]
target: [Sensus Manae nunc gradus 20 est!]

source: [Pushing your senses to the limit, you gained the sub-skill, Detailed Mana Sense!]
target: [Propter sensus tuos ad ultimum protrudendo, adeptus es sub-peritia, Sensus Manae Elaboratus!]

source: [Detailed Mana Sense: Level MAX (Passive) The feedback from your Mana Sense is much more detailed. It also enhances information-gathering skills.]
target: [Sensus Manae Elaboratus: Gradus MAX (Passivum) Responsio ex Senso Manae tuo multo elaborata est. Etiam peritiae informationis colligendae augetur.]

source: [Focused Mana Sense is Level 5!]
target: [Sensus Manae Concentatus nunc gradus 5 est!]

source: [Mana Synergy is now Level 6!]
target: [Synergia Manae nunc gradus 6 est!]

source: Sam checked the subskill with a satisfying feeling. Detailed Mana Sense was an excellent supporting skill that would pay dividends later down the line when intricate manaworks would become the norm.
target: Sam sub-peritiam recognovit cum sensu satisfactoria. Sensus Manae Elaboratus erat peritia subsidialis optima, quae postea dividendos afferet, cum operae intricatae manae ut norma fient.

source: Some of his spells also leveled up. Mainly Wind Blade and Earth Wall, as he made use of them generously during the fight against the horde of giant grasshoppers.
target: Nonnulla incantamenta eius etiam gradum attigerunt. Praesertim "Lamina Venti" et "Murus Terrae", quas liberaliter utebatur in pugna contra catervam locustarum gigantum.

source: They respectively reached Level 5 and 7 during the battle.
target: In certamine respective gradus 5 et 7 attigerunt.

source: There were not many gains in any of his other spells, but Mana Strike shot up to 8 and Mana Slash was maxed out, gaining him another sub-skill.
target: Non multa incrementa in aliis incantamentis eius facta sunt, sed "Mana Strike" attigit gradum 8, et "Mana Slash" ad maximum pervenit, adeptus est nova sub-peritia.

source: [Mana Strike is now Level 8!]
target: [Mana Strike nunc gradus 8 est!]

source: [Mana Slash is now Level 10!]
target: [Mana Slash nunc gradus 10 est!]

source: [Using your mana efficiently and creatively, you gained the sub-skill, Efficient Mana Slash!]
target: [Per efficacem et creativam usum mana tuae, adeptus es sub-peritia, Mana Slash Efficax!]

source: [Efficient Mana Slash: Level 0/5 (0%) (Passive) Thanks to your familiarity and efficiency in the use of the skill it requires much less mana to execute a Mana Slash. Decreased the cost of the spell by 10% per level.]
target: [Mana Slash Efficax: Gradus 0/5 (0%) (Passivum) Propter familiaritatem tuam et efficientiam in usu huius peritiae, multo minus mana requiritur ad peragendum Mana Slash. Sumptus incantationis decrescit 10% pro uno gradu.]

source: Aside from that, Mage Sight only gained a level as he barely used it, knowing that looking at illusions at his level would be beyond useless, while Mana Body Enhancement also shot up.
target: Praeter hoc, "Vis Magi" solum gradum attigit, quod vix usus esset, scientes quod in suo gradu illusiones contemplari ultra inutile esset, dum "Mana Body Enhancement" quoque ascendit.

source: [Mana Body Enhancement is now Level 17!]
target: [Mana Body Enhancement nunc gradus 17 est!]

source: Battling with a pet was always nice, and it increased his connection with Lucky, but sadly, no new sub-skill was created from it.
target: Pugnare cum familia animalium semper iucundum erat, et coniunctionem eius cum Lucky auxit, sed, heu, nulla nova sub-peritia ex hoc creata est.

source: Though Lucky managed to gain a few levels, now sitting at a respectable Level 9.
target: Etsi Lucky paucos gradus adeptus est, nunc in statu respectable gradus 9 sedet.

source: He stopped for a moment, took a look around, checking to see if the landmarks guiding him were still where he left them, and of course, he also checked if he was in an illusion.
target: Paulisper cessavit, circumspiciens, examinans utrum signa itineris, quae eum ducebant, adhuc eodem loco, quo reliquerat, essent, et scilicet, etiam comprobavit se in illusione esse.

source: Thankfully, the only thing that happened when he used his magic to disrupt any potential illusions around was that the monster sitting on his head let out a musical huff.
target: Gratias Deo, sola res quae evenit, dum magiam suam ad perturbandas illusiones potentiales usus est, fuit quod monstrum super caput eius huff musicum edidit.

source: Not even commenting, he began running once again.
target: Ne commentus quidem faciens, iterum currere inceperat.

source: He wanted to be done with the quest as fast as possible.
target: Cupiebat celerissime missionem absolvere.

source: While keeping an eye on the forest, though with the monster snugly on his head, there was little chance that any other monster would attack him, he turned his remaining attention to something else.
target: Dum silvam intuebatur, et cum monstrum arcte in caput eius stetisset, parva erat occasio ut aliud monstrum eum oppugnaret, et reliquam attentionem ad tabulas notificationum revertebat.

source: [Multitasking is now Level 28!]
target: [Multitasking nunc gradus 28 est!]

source: [Efficiency is now Level 4!]
target: [Efficientia nunc gradus 4 est!]

source: [Pinpoint Accuracy is now Level 5!]
target: [Exacta Praecisio nunc gradus 5 est!]

source: [Intermediate Sword Mastery is now Level 9!]
target: [Peritia Ensis Intermedia nunc gradus 9 est!]

source: [Stable Stance is now Level 3!]
target: [Stabilis Habitudo nunc gradus 3 est!]

source: [Calm Heart is now Level 10!]
target: [Cor Tranquillum nunc gradus 10 est!]

source: Then came some of the most interesting ones.
target: Deinde aliqua ex iis maxime iucunda apparuerunt.

source: [Shadow Cloak is now level 9!]
target: [Pallium Umbrarum nunc gradus 9 est!]

source: [You successfully broke through with two skills!]
target: [Duo peritiae feliciter penetraverunt!]

source: [Basic Footwork has reached Level 10 and can be upgraded into Intermediate Footwork. However, thanks to dipping your feet into the shadows, you are capable of upgrading the skill into Shadow Footwork.]
target: [Fundamentalis Gressus nunc gradus 10 attigerunt et in Gressus Intermedios elevari possunt. Attamen, propter pedes tuos in umbras immergentes, habilis es ad hanc peritiam in Gressus Umbrae elevandam.]

source: [Upgrading it into Shadow Footwork will leave you with the abilities granted by Basic Footwork, but you will not be able to learn Intermediate Footwork and above, locking you into the path of Shadows.]
target: [Elevatio eius in Gressus Umbrae tibi dona fundamentalia Gressuum relinquet, sed discere Gressus Intermedios et ultra non poteris, te in semita Umbrae clausurum.]

source: [Upgrade into Intermediate Footwork or Shadow Footwork?]
target: [Elevare in Gressus Intermedios an in Gressus Umbrae?]

source: Sam didn’t even hesitate.
target: Sam quidem etiam non dubitavit.

source: [Basic Footwork has been upgraded into Shadow Footwork.]
target: [Fundamentalis Gressus elevatus est in Gressus Umbrae.]

source: [Shadow Footwork: Level 0/50 (0%) (Passive) You have mastered the basics of footwork. Your stance is stable and hidden in the shadows. Observers will have a harder time figuring out your next action based on the movement of your feet. When traveling in shadows, your speed increases. Grants the Shadow Burst skill.]
target: [Gressus Umbrae: Gradus 0/50 (0%) (Passivum) Fundamenta gressuum adeptus es. Statura tua stabilis est et in umbris abscondita; observatores magis laborabunt ut sequentem actum tuum ex motu pedum tuorum intellegant. In umbris iter facientes, celeritas tua augetur. Donat peritiam “Eruptionis Umbrae”.]

source: [Shadow Burst: Level 0/10 (0%) (Active) Activating the skill will increase your speed by 100% for 1 second. Cooldown: 180 seconds.]
target: [Eruptio Umbrae: Gradus 0/10 (0%) (Activa) Incitando peritiam, celeritatem tuam auges 100% per 1 secundam. Refrigeratio: 180 secundae.]

source: Nodding in satisfaction, he only gave a cursory read of the other skill that broke through.
target: Annuens cum satisfactione, reliquam peritiam breviter legere conatus est.

source: [Basic Breathing Technique has reached Level 10 and upgraded into Intermediate Breathing Technique.]
target: [Fundamentalis Technica Respirationis nunc gradus 10 attigit et in Technicam Respirationis Intermediam elevata est!]

source: [Intermediate Breathing Technique: Level 0/10 (0%) (Passive) You gained control over your breathing. The very air you breathe sustains you. Decreases stamina consumption during any activity and increases stamina regeneration when not in a fight.]
target: [Technica Respirationis Intermedia: Gradus 0/10 (0%) (Passivum) Imperium super respirationem adeptus es. Ipsa aura quam spiraris te sustinet. Consumptio virium in quacumque activitate minuitur atque regeneratio virium, cum non pugnaris, augetur.]

source: Sadly, none of them granted sub-skills. Not that he expected them to, they were basic skills that only the truly talented, or those under specific teachers got sub‑skills for Basic Footwork and Basic Breathing Technique. And Sam was nowhere near talented enough for that or able to approach those teachers.
target: Heu, nullae ex eis sub‑peritiae dederunt. Non quod id exspectaret; erant studia fundamentalia, quarum tantum vere ingeniosi aut sub magistris certis sub‑peritiae acceperunt. Et Sam minime ingeniosus erat nec ad illos magistros accedere poterat.

source: But instead of feeling sad, he was happy. After all, he had new skills to check out!
target: Sed pro tristitia, laetus erat. Postremo, novas peritias habebat explorandas!

source: [Thanks to your accomplishment, you gained the skill Illusion Resistance!]
target: [Propter successum tuum, adeptus es peritia "Resistentiae Illusionis"!]

source: [Illusion Resistance: 0/100 (0%) (Passive) Thanks to your experience, you gained resistance against illusions. Makes it easier to resist and spot illusions. Each level increases the resistance by 1%.]
target: [Resistentia Illusionis: Gradus 0/100 (0%) (Passivum) Propter experientiam tuam, resistentia contra illusiones adeptus es. Facit facilem deprehensionem illusionum, et quisque gradus resistentiam auget per 1%.]

source: [Thanks to your accomplishment, you gained the skill Mana Disruption!]
target: [Propter successum tuum, adeptus es peritia "Disturbationis Manae"!]

source: [Mana Disruption: 0/20 (0%) (Active) Using your finely honed control over your mana you can disrupt mana constructs. Mana cost depends on the mana construct you are disrupting.]
target: [Disturbatio Manae: Gradus 0/20 (0%) (Activa) Utendo subtili moderamine super manam tuam, potes structuras manae perturbare. Sumptus manae dependet ex structura manae quam perturbas.]

source: Two very nice spells that will definitely come in handy. Especially the resistance skill. They were wicked hard to acquire.
target: Dua incantamenta valde iucunda, quae certe utilia erunt. Praesertim peritia resistentiae. Valde difficilia erant adipisci.

source: For example, the easiest way to get the Fire Resistance skill was by executing a ritual in a volcano.
target: Exempli causa, facilis modus ad peritiam “Resistentiae Ignis” obtinendam fuit per exsecutionem ritu in volcāno.

source: Apparently, the monster on his head (currently whistling an unknown song), whose name he still didn’t know, was a masterful enough illusion user, that Sam noticing the illusion was enough of an accomplishment to get the skill.
target: Apparenter, monstrum super caput eius (nunc carmen ignotum sibilans), cuius nomen eum nondum noverat, peritus in usu illusionum erat, ut Sam ipsi notare illusionem satis esset ad peritiam adeptandam.

source: Giving one last look at his status screen, Sam gave one rather satisfied nod, closed it and began pumping his legs.
target: Sam, ultimam paginam status suam aspexit, capite contento annuit, eam clausit, et crura movere coepit.

source: He could see the trunks of the trees slowly changing into that of ironwood trees, as well as the mountain coming closer.
target: Videbat truncos arborum paulatim in truncos arborum ligni ferrei mutari, atque montem appropinquare.

source: It was time for the next leg of his journey…
target: Tempus erat pro parte secunda itineris eius…
